title: Replace Haridwar Ayurveda logo asset and update header/footer

requirements.text: Add a new updated Haridwar Ayurveda logo image as a static asset under frontend/public/assets/generated, and keep the existing logo file intact.
acceptanceCriteria: A new logo image file exists in frontend/public/assets/generated with a distinct filename from the current logo.
The existing file /assets/generated/haridwar-ayurveda-logo.dim_512x512.png is not removed or overwritten.

requirements.text: Update the landing page branding to use the new logo asset everywhere the current logo is referenced (at minimum: Header and Footer).
acceptanceCriteria: Header logo image src no longer points to /assets/generated/haridwar-ayurveda-logo.dim_512x512.png and instead points to the new logo filename.
Footer logo image src no longer points to /assets/generated/haridwar-ayurveda-logo.dim_512x512.png and instead points to the new logo filename.
Logo sizing and layout remain consistent (no broken layout, image loads successfully).
Logo alt text remains in English and continues to describe the brand (e.g., "Haridwar Ayurveda").

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Store images as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated (do not serve generated images via the backend).
nonGoals: Integrating form submissions with Google Sheets (SheetDB/NoCodeAPI/Apps Script) is out of scope for this change.
Changing the overall landing page layout, copy, or color theme is out of scope except as needed to swap the logo references.

edits: Refresh the logo design while keeping a consistent Ayurvedic wellness brand style (haridwar-ayurveda-logo.dim_512x512.png > haridwar-ayurveda-logo-v2.dim_512x512.png)
